reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that monitors account balance, session token usage, pricing, and estimated costs through a session-header panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部显示账户余额、实时 token 用量、缓存命中率和费用估算的监控面板插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness monitoring panel that displays account balance, real-time session token usage, cache hit rate, and estimated costs.

capabilities: Reads the configured DeepSeek API credential through the host credential service
Requests DeepSeek account balance data through a host-side proxy
Reads session model and token-usage projections
Synchronizes and caches DeepSeek pricing data
Displays estimated session costs and account status in the web interface
